The Wall Crematorium is a location in the Souls Room, accessible with the [[Better Save Soul]] DLC. Up to two can be built on the north wall. Unlike the outside [[Crematorium]], they are permanent structures that require [[Fuel]]. <br> '''Take note:''' that using the {{PAGENAME}} will provide two less [[Ash]] per body when compared to the outside [[Crematorium]]. That being said, it uses significantly less wood to burn a corpse.

The amount of retrievable materials is not dependent on the remaining body parts, meaning a fully extracted body with no body parts left inside will yield the same amount of ash as a corpse with all body parts remaining. 

The amount of wood needed to burn a single body in the wall crematorium is significantly less than what a funeral pyre would need. Even with the most basic skills. The [[firewood]] made from the [[Wood billet|Wood billets]] at base skills is 80, and that provides 30 fuel a piece. making the wall crematorium 120 times more efficient.
